hook: Your House Is Worth Less Than Your Agent Told You
subhead: Get a written cash offer in 24 hours with no repairs, no showings, no commission
agitate: Agent estimates are aspirational. The number that matters is what a buyer will actually wire.
Repairs, staging, and 6% commission come out of your side of the table.
Every month you hold costs you in taxes, insurance, and maintenance.
mechanism: We buy directly, so there is no listing, no agent commission, and no financing contingency to fall through.
proof: Written offer within 24 hours of your walkthrough
You choose the closing date — 10 days or 10 months
No repairs, no cleaning, we handle the paperwork fees
magnet_desc: A short guide covering exactly how a direct cash sale works, the true cost comparison against listing, and what to check before you sign anything.
